parsed.summary: The drawing implements the architecture the specification describes (CM4 carrier, two MCP2515 CAN nodes U8/U9 with 16 MHz crystals Y1/Y2, isolated transceivers U10/U11, SM712 TVS arrays, LTC4412+PMOS USB ideal-diode U6/Q1, the SN74LVC1G07 e-stop sink chain U15/U22/U35/U36 feeding ESTOP_OUT to J2/J13, WS2812 string D5-D7/D18-D21, and ISL54222 analog switches U5/U24), and every value the spec pins down matches. The remaining apparent discrepancies (RTC as a docs pointer, GLOBAL_EN with no delay chip, USB diode note, CAN-LED polarity, e-stop cable-disconnect behavior) are all documented known issues/open TODOs, not deviations, so no anomaly is reported.
